meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Apply clear-writing standards to any prose the agent produces - READMEs, docs, UI copy, error messages, commit and PR text, release notes. Use when writing or editing documentation, interface copy, or any text a human will read. Says "write the README", "improve this copy", "draft the docs", "word this error".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让任何面向用户的文字都符合清晰写作标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要写README、文档或UI文案，希望它们清晰易读。
copy.tagline_en: Apply clear-writing standards to any prose the agent produces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write READMEs, docs, or UI copy and want them clear and readable.

howto.what: Claude 会按照清晰写作标准改写或创作文本，包括 README、文档、界面文案、错误消息、提交信息、发布说明等。它会先写结果，删掉废话，用具体词代替抽象词，用主动语态和短句，保持术语一致，并去除 AI 写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 写或编辑文档、界面文案、错误消息等人类会读的文本时触发。例如说“写 README”、“改进这段文案”、“起草文档”、“给这个错误写提示”。

say.text: 写一个 README，说明这个工具是做什么的。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个以结果开头的 README。

say.text: 改进这段错误消息：Error: config missing。
say.note: Claude 会重写为“发生了什么+下一步怎么做”的格式。

say.text: 给这个提交写一条发布说明。
say.note: Claude 会输出简洁、具体的说明。

howto.what_en: Claude will rewrite or create text following clear-writing standards: lead with outcome, cut filler, use concrete terms, active voice, short sentences, consistent terms, and strip AI-slop tells. Applies to READMEs, docs, UI copy, error messages, commit/PR text, release notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write or edit documentation, interface copy, error messages, or any text a human will read. Example requests: "write the README", "improve this copy", "draft the docs", "word this error".

say_en.text: Write a README that explains what this tool does.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a README starting with the outcome.

say_en.text: Improve this error message: Error: config missing.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite it as 'what happened + what to do next'.

say_en.text: Write a release note for this commit.
say_en.note: Claude will output concise, concrete notes.
